program: Wingless training-only control for productive versus false-positive motif churn
question: Can prediction-active motif churn distinguish productive adaptation intervals from zero-gain motif-churn false positives on the fourth manifest before any allocator signal is revised?
hypothesis: Replay the exact fourth manifest and R23 budget grids. For every adjacent interval with motif_entry_count+motif_exit_count>0, freeze a training-only prediction-active-churn control: an entering motif is active iff its upper-budget motif.best differs from the upper-budget baseline argmax for motif.key[3]; an exiting motif is active iff its lower-budget motif.best differs from the lower-budget baseline argmax for motif.key[3]. control_signal=active_churn_count/interval_bytes. Compute all control values before any sealed evaluation hit count. Then open the same 582-byte sealed evaluation slices only to label each churn interval as PRODUCTIVE when actual gain>0 or ZERO_GAIN when actual gain==0. No interval is excluded after labels are seen. Supported requires at least one PRODUCTIVE and one ZERO_GAIN churn interval, mean control_signal(PRODUCTIVE)>mean control_signal(ZERO_GAIN), and pairwise AUC>=0.75. This experiment does not change the R23 baseline confidence gate, motif weight, candidate allocations, or allocator.

prior_evidence.interpretation: Baseline confidence gating removed the R21 baseline-only false-positive class but a motif-churn-only interval still produced positive predicted value with zero sealed gain.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_contract.interval_inclusion: all adjacent intervals with motif_entry_count+motif_exit_count>0; inclusion is determined before evaluation labels
frozen_contract.entering_active_rule: upper-budget motif.best != upper-budget baseline argmax for motif.key[3]
frozen_contract.exiting_active_rule: lower-budget motif.best != lower-budget baseline argmax for motif.key[3]
frozen_contract.negative_gain_label: sealed actual exact-hit gain < 0; reported separately and included as nonproductive in diagnostics but not silently dropped

classification_rules.supported: valid, at least one productive and one zero-gain churn interval exist, mean productive control_signal > mean zero-gain control_signal, and productive-vs-zero pairwise AUC >= 0.75
classification_rules.mixed: valid and mean productive control_signal > mean zero-gain control_signal with AUC > 0.5 but < 0.75
classification_rules.negative: valid and the prediction-active-churn control does not rank productive intervals above zero-gain intervals
classification_rules.invalid: any parent, authority, source identity, split, grid, interval inclusion, active-churn definition, label isolation, deterministic replay, capacity, provenance, or accounting requirement fails

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter sources, budgets, baseline argmax definition, active-churn rules, interval inclusion, control formula, sealed-gain labels, AUC threshold, evaluator, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: combine the already frozen baseline-margin gate and prediction-active-churn control without refitting either component, then validate prospectively on another disjoint manifest before allocator use

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: factor motif support, consistency and baseline-disagreement features before changing the allocator signal
